# EnquiryBazaar (EnquiryBazaar.in)
> India's Dedicated B2B Lead Generation, End-to-End Digital Presence, and Google/Meta Ads Partner for Manufacturers & Factory Owners.

EnquiryBazaar provides a complete "Done-For-You" B2B Buyer Acquisition Engine and Digital Transformation Service for Indian manufacturing MSMEs, factory owners, and wholesale suppliers. Founded by Software Engineer and serial entrepreneur Amit Pandey (Ex-Founder of Devlo.in), EnquiryBazaar replaces rented directory listing portals (like IndiaMART and Justdial) with permanent Google #1 SEO rankings, factory showroom websites, targeted B2B Google & Meta ads, and industrial video trust proof.

## Leadership & Founder Profile
- **Founder**: Amit Pandey
- **Title**: Software Engineer & Founder, EnquiryBazaar
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/amit-pandey-86aa62338/
- **Background**: Serial tech founder who previously established and profitably ran **Devlo.in** (software engineering agency run through June 2026). Amit has architected 100+ business platforms, built a multi-tenant SaaS serving 200+ businesses, and worked hands-on with 20+ Indian manufacturers across industrial sectors.
- **Philosophy**: *"A website is not the destination. It is a foundation for business growth."*
- **Growth Framework**: Discoverable → Credible → Accessible → Enquiry-Ready.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. B2B Lead Generation & Direct Buyer Acquisition
- Delivers 100% exclusive, verified incoming bulk RFQs, phone inquiries, and WhatsApp quote requests directly to the manufacturer's sales team.
- Zero lead-sharing: Unlike IndiaMART or Justdial where leads are forwarded to 8–10 competitors, EnquiryBazaar leads are 100% private to the client.
- 0% commission on orders closed.

### 2. End-to-End Complete Digital Presence Setup & Management
- 100% Done-For-You: From domain registration, Google Business Profile (GMB) verification, and SEO rank #1 optimization to high-converting factory showroom websites and digital product catalogs.
- Full digital asset ownership: The manufacturer permanently owns 100% of the domain, code, Google rankings, and customer database.
- Dedicated B2B Growth Manager assigned to handle all daily technical updates, SEO maintenance, and website upgrades.

### 3. High-Performance B2B Google Ads & Meta Ads Management
- Specialized in industrial and B2B pay-per-click (PPC) campaigns.
- Advanced negative keyword filtering that actively blocks retail bargain hunters, single-piece buyers, and job seekers.
- Targeted Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads delivering factory capability reels and wholesale rate cards directly into the feeds of procurement officers, distributors, and shopkeepers.
